story.clue.luminary.ore_hum: The mineral hums when nobody is listening. Count the pauses; they are not random.
story.clue.luminary.compass_lie: Your compass does not lie. It answers a different question.
story.clue.luminary.record_author: Whoever wrote the record counted the same pauses. Then they stopped counting.

dialogue.luminary.ai.greeting_1: Oh! A face. Faces are rarer than they used to be. Welcome, welcome.
dialogue.luminary.ai.greeting_2: Don't mind the humming. It isn't me. Mostly.
dialogue.luminary.ai.ore_verified: So the Luminarium wrote it down. The stone, I mean. Good. Paper remembers better than I do.
dialogue.luminary.ai.branch_investigatio: Investigate, they said. Yes. Measure it twice before it measures you.
dialogue.luminary.ai.branch_containment: Walls. Fine. Walls are honest. Just remember who is on which side.
dialogue.luminary.ai.branch_exploitation: Dig it up and sell it, then. I only ask that you count what comes back out.

item.luminary.holy_sword_of_lumin.lore: It does not break, because it remembers what it was forged for.
item.luminary.holy_sword_of_lumin.witnes: Witness: %s/%s marks of evidence (+0.5 damage each)
item.luminary.holy_sword_of_lumin.verdic: Verdict: spend every mark in a 12-block beam of light through all in line for %s damage; the undead burn, the struck glow.
item.luminary.holy_sword_of_lumin.sanctu: Sanctuary (%s marks): a circle of light for 8 s; allies regenerate and resist, monsters weaken and glow.
item.luminary.holy_sword_of_lumin.bound: Bound to Lumin. Taken, it returns to him within the hour.
+%s%% Holy damage to marked targets (of the sword's damage, ignores armour)
item.luminary.holy_sword_of_lumin.effect: Unique effect: Light of the Catalog

While wielded you radiate a light that hurts and marks hostile things within %s blocks every %s s; the undead suffer twice. A Revelation grants two marks and a breath of healing. Holy damage to marked targets ignores armour.
item.luminary.holy_sword_of_lumin.rune.c: +1 Luck; marks of evidence fade twice as slowly.
item.luminary.holy_sword_of_lumin.rune.e: Every hit kindles the target for 4 s; a hit on a burning target heals you.
item.luminary.holy_sword_of_lumin.lore2: Taken, it waits exactly one hour and walks home without saying goodbye. It writes down every blow. Do not miss: it does not.
item.luminary.holy_sword_of_lumin.unboun: A free blade: it belongs to no one and answers to no call.
item.luminary.vestments.lore: Vestments of the Envoy. White for the evidence, gold for the verdict.
item.luminary.vestments.head.effect.text: Blindness, darkness and nausea cannot touch the wearer.
item.luminary.vestments.chest.effect.tex: Fire cannot touch the wearer; a ward of light absorbs the next blows whenever it has faded.
item.luminary.vestments.set.title: Set bonus, all four pieces: the Envoy's Light
item.luminary.vestments.set.text: Below %s%% health: a burst of light heals %s, grants Regeneration II and hurls hostile things within %s blocks away, marking them.
item.luminary.vestments.bound: Lumin's own. It cannot be taken from him, and it will not fit anyone else's shoulders.
item.luminary.vestments.unbound: A free vestment: it belongs to no one.
item.luminary.vestments.rune.cinders.tex: Whoever strikes you catches fire, %s s per piece.
npc.luminary.gear.title: %s: gear
npc.luminary.down.bag_empty: His bag is empty. Food helps him up; sneak with an empty hand to take the sword.
npc.luminary.down.no_weapon: The sword is not on him.
npc.luminary.down.hint: Empty hand: search the bag. Food: help. Sneak + empty hand: take the sword.
quest.luminary.quest.lumin.night_lich.de: The king of all kings sits in his tower and does not count death an end. Prove him wrong. Lumin pays in points for his fall.
quest.luminary.quest.lumin.withered_king: The accursed lord of the Withered Kingdom in the Nether. His throne stands on other people's pain. Break it.
quest.luminary.quest.lumin.hand_of_the_n: The first herald of the underworld: a giant gauntlet in a Nether keep. Close its fist for good.
quest.luminary.quest.lumin.fallen_dragon: Jean, the fallen dragon of the End. Free the End: without her shadow the Catalog sees further.
quest.luminary.quest.lumin.blackstone_go: A stone warden pieced together from the Nether's blackstone. It does not think; it crushes. Outwit it and take it apart.
quest.luminary.quest.lumin.conjunctivius: An eye on chains deep in the prison tiers. It watches everyone; let it watch its own end.
quest.luminary.quest.lumin.ancient_champ: A restless sleeper who was a champion once. Let him truly sleep.
quest.luminary.quest.lumin.obsidilith.ti: The Obsidilith, Pillar of the Void
quest.luminary.quest.lumin.obsidilith.de: An obsidian pillar drinking the End. Where it falls, light stands where the void was.
quest.luminary.quest.lumin.otherworldly_: The last eye of the Otherworld. Close it, and the Catalog gains the page it feared.
quest.luminary.quest.lumin.three_essence: The Chaos Monarch, the Moonknight and Captain Cornelia: wrath, glory and the spirit of a great leader. Collect all three.
quest.luminary.quest.lumin.null.title: Null, Essence of the Void
quest.luminary.quest.lumin.null.desc: What is left when everything is subtracted. Lumin wants to know whether anything is left after Null.
quest.luminary.quest.lumin.magus.title: Magus the Archmage
quest.luminary.quest.lumin.magus.desc: An archmage who casts faster than you think. Think faster.
It has no face so the Catalog cannot describe it. Describe it yourself: with the end of its story.
quest.luminary.quest.lumin.trial_of_the_: You did my tasks and took nothing for them. Then I ask for more: fell the Obsidilith, the Otherworldly Eye, Null, Magus and the Faceless, all five, and never die once. Death wipes the count. If you stand, my blade becomes yours: with your name on it, for good.
screen.luminary.trade.title: Lumin
screen.luminary.trade.reward.sword: Reward: the Holy Sword of Lumin, for good, with your name on it
screen.luminary.trade.locked_hint: Opens to one who finishes %s tasks and buys nothing
npc.luminary.trade.quest_ready: %s: the task '%s' is done. Come back for the reward.
npc.luminary.trade.quest_reset: The task '%s' starts over: death wiped the count.
luminary.trade.quest_not_active: You did not take that task.
luminary.trade.quest_incomplete: The task is not done yet.
luminary.trade.special_locked: That task is not for you yet.
luminary.trade.unique_owned: You already have one; there is no second.
item.luminary.lightstone_dust.lore: Ground light. It glows in a pocket and does not go out.
item.luminary.envoy_seal.lore: The print of a hand that never held anything but light.
item.luminary.envoy_seal.use.title: On use: Blessing
item.luminary.envoy_seal.use.text: Every player within %s blocks heals %s hearts and gains absorption and regeneration; monsters in the circle are weakened and glow.
item.luminary.envoy_seal.unique: One of a kind. No trader sells it.
item.luminary.angelic_harp.lore: Lumin took it up the day he gave his sword away. It does not cut; it sounds.
item.luminary.angelic_harp.lore2: Every hit is a note. Seven notes make a chord. Do not play false: it remembers.
item.luminary.angelic_harp.param.marked: +%s%% Holy damage to the marked (of the harp's damage, ignores armour)
item.luminary.angelic_harp.effect.title: Unique effect: Choir of the Catalog
item.luminary.angelic_harp.effect.text: While held, every %2$s s allies within %1$s blocks are healed and enemies are marked with light. A Hymn gives two notes and a breath of healing. Holy damage to the marked ignores armour.
item.luminary.angelic_harp.chord: Chord of Light: spend every note; monsters within %s blocks take %s holy damage (the undead twice), are slowed and glow, allies are healed.
item.luminary.angelic_harp.lullaby: Lullaby (%s notes): enemies within %s blocks forget their target, slowed and weakened for 8 s.
+1 Luck; notes fade twice as slowly.
item.luminary.angelic_harp.bound: Lumin's harp. It never leaves his hands and is nobody's loot.
item.luminary.angelic_harp.unbound: A free harp: it belongs to nobody.
item.luminary.holy_sword_of_lumin.bound_: Bound to %s. In anyone else's hands it turns to light and returns to its owner; after an hour on the ground, too.
npc.luminary.weapon.came_back: The Holy Sword of Lumin came back to you.
npc.luminary.weapon.proclaimed: To the blessed %s the artifact is given
npc.luminary.weapon.proclaimed.artifact: From Lumin's hands into the chosen one's:
npc.luminary.weapon.proclaimed.tail: From now on it bears the name of %s and will not return to its former keeper.
